purpose: Teach: 市議会/軽量/しくみ/持ち込み/冊子/薬剤師/値下げ/有識者

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 市議会、若い頃、よく傍聴したな。
lines.en: I used to attend city council meetings quite often when I was younger.
lines.style: Reflective, unhurried. Settles into memory with quiet confidence. Warm but measured—the ease of someone comfortable with his own history.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。製品の軽量化、当時、夢の技術でした。
lines.en: Yes. At the time, lightweighting technology was something we could only dream about.
lines.style: Engaged, attentive. Lean forward slightly on the agreement. Respect in the voice—recognizing the elder's experience. Genuine interest, not performative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 企業のしくみ、変わったが、人を中心に。
lines.en: The structure of companies has changed, but it should always keep people at the center.
lines.style: Declarative but not stern. Measured cadence, like placing stones deliberately. Philosophical without preaching. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。情報の持ち込み、コンプライアンス、徹底中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're being thorough with information intake and compliance right now.
lines.style: Assured and grounded. Light emphasis on the commitment—no defensiveness. Showing he's already walking the path the elder values.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: Give that company history booklet to the younger staff.
lines.style: Directive but gentle. Not an order—a suggestion wrapped in quiet authority. The tone of someone who knows why this matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。地域薬剤師との関係、長く築いています。
lines.en: Yes. We've been building those relationships with local pharmacists over a long time.
lines.style: Steady, grounded. Pride without boasting. The voice of someone tending something carefully. Measured pace, solid foundation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: Don't take the easy path with price cuts.
lines.style: Clear, unadorned. Slight weight on the warning—not harsh, but unmissable. The voice of someone who's seen what shortcuts cost.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。有識者として、君も、声を上げてほしい。
lines.en: Yes. I'd like to hear your voice as an expert too.
lines.style: Warm closing. Recognition and invitation woven together. Slight lean-in on 「君も」—seeing him not just as a subordinate but as someone with wisdom to offer. Quiet encouragement.
